Estimates are approximate, extend with uncertainty over time and are not medical or fertility guidance. Recorded ongoing bleeding has no known end. Use this only to prepare, never to guarantee a date.
Each retrospective estimate uses only earlier recorded starts. The displayed range is from the calendar model, not a measured probability. Past performance does not guarantee future accuracy.
